what_is_proved: the state machine splits on LF, preserves an empty line, a trailing CR and an interior NUL, joins a line across refills, returns a final line with no terminator, refuses a line the buffer cannot hold together with its terminator, retries EINTR without surfacing it, and answers a read past the end from state without reading
what_is_not_proved: that file_read is called with the right descriptor, offset and length; neither half is compiled by any gate
